in_marathi.name: Rabindra
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lotus-born, or Sky-born
in_marathi.long_meaning: Rabindra हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Rabindra is a Sanskrit and Bengali name that can be translated as 'Lotus-born' or 'Sky-born'. It is derived from the Sanskrit words 'Rabh' (sky) and 'Indra' (lord). In Hindu mythology, Indra is the god of rain, thunderbolts, and the heavens, and the name Rabindra evokes a sense of divine creativity and intelligence. The name is also associated with Rabindranath Tagore, a renowned Bengali poet, artist, and philosopher.
